verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable at docs.metronome.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). The docs also offer a Postman collection for exploring the API. Missing for 10: a first-party docs page describing the spec download and its versioning, and verification that the spec covers every endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.metronome.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Postman is a great way to visually explore the Metronome API without writing code.
